Long Haul

Carte de point d’égalité de temps

A chart used in flight planning to determine the point at which the flight time to two alternate aerodromes is equal, commonly applied for ETOPS and long-range operations.

Quick answer: A chart used in flight planning to determine the point at which the flight time to two alternate aerodromes is equal, commonly applied for ETOPS and long-range operations.

Questions and answers

What is Carte de point d’égalité de temps?

In this glossary, Carte de point d’égalité de temps refers to: A chart used in flight planning to determine the point at which the flight time to two alternate aerodromes is equal, commonly applied for ETOPS and long-range operations.

How is Carte de point d’égalité de temps used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Selon la carte de point d’égalité de temps, l’ETP est situé au point 45 Nord 030 Ouest entre Shannon et Gander."

Definition

A chart used in flight planning to determine the point at which the flight time to two alternate aerodromes is equal, commonly applied for ETOPS and long-range operations.

Operational example

According to the equal time chart, ETP is located over waypoint 45 North 030 West between Shannon and Gander.

Localized term

Carte de point d’égalité de temps

Localized example

Selon la carte de point d’égalité de temps, l’ETP est situé au point 45 Nord 030 Ouest entre Shannon et Gander.
